text:
maya: quick design flag — the rail scanline feels noisy when policies have many small rules. users get lost in vertical rhythm. thinking about a 'compact scanline' with micro-cards + inline icons to improve density. :mag:

samir: I like micro-cards. we should still show primary affordances: drag, enable toggle, and rule name. collapse description into a hover/focus panel instead of inline.

olivia: micro-cards + inline icons works. one concern: users rely on quick glance metadata (region/model/priority). propose an icon tooltip that surfaces that data on hover/focus; keyboard users can press ? to expand.

maya: also want a better keyboard reorder flow — current handle is fiddly. propose a 'reorder lock' toggle that turns list into a keyboard-first control set (up/down buttons, visible focus ring, aria-live updates).

jess: accessibility checklist: 1) aria-live text for moves: "Moved 'Rule A' to position 3"; 2) focus stays on moved element; 3) collapse state announced when toggling compact mode. do we have copy for that?

maya: draft aria copy: "Compact mode enabled. Use arrow keys to focus rules. Press M to open metadata." happy to iterate.

samir: simulator note — when priorities tie and actions conflict, preview currently only emits a summary toast. that's not discoverable. suggest an inline warning badge on the conflicting rules with a quick action: "Resolve priority" which opens a mini-editor to add a guard or change priority.

olivia: +1. pill copy suggestion: "Priority conflict" with tooltip: "Two rules share the same priority and produce different actions. Add a guard or adjust priority to make routing deterministic." keep it short.

maya: another sim idea: show a tiny sparklines row under each rule representing relative hit counts from the preview sample. hover reveals exact counts; legend in footer. low-contrast by default, and provide text summary for screen readers.

deploy-bot: preview-sim: sparklines added to staging; run `preview-sim --policy 101 --samples 250` to refresh. logs: /staging/sim/101.

jess: good. ensure sparklines have non-color indicator (e.g., small dot or label) and aria-describedby summarizing top 3 rules. i'll draft the announcement strings.

samir: action items: olivia to update Figma with micro-card + icon tooltips + badge, jess to write aria-live and sparklines descriptions, maya to refine compact-mode microcopy and the resolve-priority quick-action. i'll add acceptance criteria to the spec.

olivia: targeting mock drop by next Wed.

maya: nice work team — thanks! :raised_hands:
